Instant withdrawals for verified accounts (automatically processed up to 5,000 dollars per day) and its proprietary social trading (copytrade) platform are key highlights. On the other hand, accounts opened from Turkey are linked to an offshore entity rather than the CySEC-regulated EU entity — this is the main reason limiting the regulation score of this review.

lite-finance.faq.0.a: Lite Finance has been operating since 2005 and works through three separate legal entities: Liteforex (Europe) Ltd (CySEC license no. 093/08, European Economic Area clients only), LiteFinance Investment Limited (Mauritius FSC, Investment Dealer license GB20025921) and LiteFinance Global LLC (Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, 931 LLC 2021 — this is a company registration, not a regulatory license). The critical distinction here is: the account you open from Turkey is linked to the offshore company, not the CySEC-regulated European entity — meaning CySEC protections such as the investor compensation fund and negative balance protection will not apply to your account. The Mauritius FSC license is a real layer of supervision, but it is not at tier-1 (FCA, ASIC, CySEC) level. Lite Finance has a Turkish support line (turkiye@litefinance.com). Be sure to check which company the contract is signed with when opening an account.
lite-finance.faq.1.q: How to withdraw money from Lite Finance?
lite-finance.faq.1.a: Withdrawal requests are created from the personal cabinet and are processed instantly on a verified (KYC completed) account when automatic withdrawal is enabled: up to $5,000 per day on supported methods, multiple times throughout the day, without waiting for anyone's approval. Most requests above this limit and outside the automatic flow are completed within 24 hours, while bank transfers take 1-3 business days. Three things are required to benefit from instant withdrawal: account verification must be completed, automatic withdrawal must be enabled in the cabinet, and the withdrawal method must support this flow (cards and e-wallets support it, bank transfer inherently does not). There are also two rules: money can only be withdrawn to the method you deposited with and in the same currency (if you deposited with Skrill, you can only withdraw to the same Skrill wallet), and a fee of 0-2% may apply depending on the method. Lite Finance does not charge fees for deposit transactions.
lite-finance.faq.2.q: What is a Lite Finance cent account, and who is it suitable for?
lite-finance.faq.2.a: In a cent account, your balance and profit/loss are shown in cents instead of dollars; the contract size is $1,000 instead of $100,000. In practice, this means trading with a $10 balance under real market conditions, with real prices, but at a risk scale 100 times smaller. Unlike a demo account, real money and real psychology are at play here — making it the most logical step for testing strategies and building your first live trading habit. In a cent account, the stop out level is 50%, leverage can be selected up to 1:1000, and there is no commission (spread starts from 3 pips).
lite-finance.faq.3.q: How much is the Lite Finance ECN account commission?
lite-finance.faq.3.a: On an ECN account, the spread starts from 0.0 pips and the cost is taken as a commission: starting from $0.25 per lot. Minimum deposit is $50, leverage up to 1:1000, stop out 20%. The ECN account is the only account type that supports cTrader alongside MT4 and MT5. For scalpers and high-frequency traders, the total of spread + commission usually produces a lower total cost than the 1.8 pip spread of the commission-free Classic account.
lite-finance.faq.4.q: How much is Lite Finance leverage, and is 1:1000 applicable to everyone?
lite-finance.faq.4.a: On Classic and ECN accounts, leverage can be selected between 1:1 and 1:1000; on a cent account, it can also go up to 1:1000. However, leverage is automatically tiered based on the instrument, position size, and account balance — meaning 1:1000 is not applied to every instrument and every lot size. High leverage increases position size, not profit potential; it increases the risk of loss at the same rate. Calculate how many lots you should open with FXPARTNER's position size calculator.
lite-finance.faq.5.q: How does Lite Finance copytrade (social trading) work?
lite-finance.faq.5.a: There are two sides on Lite Finance's proprietary social trading platform. The copying side: opens a social trading account, selects a trader from the ranking, and sets the copy type; trades are automatically reflected in your own account. Your funds are not transferred to someone else's account — they remain in your own account, and you can stop copying at any time. The recommended starting amount for copying is $50. The signal provider side: opens their trades to being copied and receives a percentage of the profit; sets their own commission rate, which is shown in the ranking. Commission is accrued only when the copying side makes a profit; the company does not charge an extra fee. The recommended amount for an account opened for copying is $500.
lite-finance.faq.6.q: Does Lite Finance offer a swap-free (Islamic) account?
lite-finance.faq.6.a: Yes. The Islamic (swap-free) account option is available on all three account types: Cent, Classic, and ECN; overnight position holding interest (swap) is not charged on these accounts. Swap-free status is defined upon request, and there may be exceptions on an instrument basis — confirm which symbols it applies to with support after opening an account.
lite-finance.faq.7.q: Is there a Lite Finance deposit bonus, and can the bonus be withdrawn?
lite-finance.faq.7.a: Lite Finance periodically releases deposit bonuses with promo codes; common ones are a 30% bonus on deposits over $50 and a 100% bonus with a promo code on deposits over $100. Two basic rules of the bonus must be known: the bonus amount is used as additional margin and cannot be withdrawn directly; to withdraw the bonus and profits derived from it, a specific trading volume (lot) requirement must be completed, and the bonus has an expiration period (usually 6 months). While the bonus reduces the probability of a margin call, it also creates an urge to enlarge the position size — opening unnecessary trades chasing the volume requirement is the most common mistake with bonuses. Confirm current conditions from Lite Finance's official website before participating.
lite-finance.faq.8.q: Is Lite Finance legal in Turkey, and does it have an SPK license?
lite-finance.faq.8.a: No — Lite Finance does not have a Capital Markets Board (SPK) license and is not an investment institution based in Turkey. Leveraged trading in Turkey can only be offered by brokerage firms authorized by the SPK; investors in Turkey who open accounts with overseas brokers remain outside the SPK's investor compensation mechanism and, in the event of a dispute, are subject to the offshore jurisdiction to which the broker is tied instead of Turkish law. This is not a situation unique to Lite Finance — it applies to all international brokers serving Turkey. Read FXPARTNER's broker regulation report before making a decision.

tio-markets.summary: TIO Markets offers a four-tier structure ranging from Nano and Standard accounts that can be opened with 20 dollars to the Raw account with raw spreads starting from 250 dollars; all operate on MT4 and MT5. The client dashboard is simple and fast, with crypto deposits and withdrawals completed within minutes. The unlimited leverage offered on the Standard account is a rare feature in the industry — and for the same reason, a feature that must be used carefully. The structural point to know is this: accounts opened from Turkey are linked to the group's offshore company in Comoros, not to the FCA-regulated UK or CySEC-regulated Cyprus company — which is what limits its regulation score.

tio-markets.faq.0.a: TIO Markets operates through three legal entities: TIO Markets UK Ltd (UK registration 06592025, FCA reference 488900, FSCS protection up to 85,000 pounds for eligible clients), TIO Markets CY Ltd (Cyprus HE399709, CySEC license 429/23), and TIO Markets Ltd (Mwali International Services Authority, Comoros, license T2023224; also registered in SVG as 24986 IBC 2018). The critical distinction is this: since Turkey is outside both the United Kingdom and the European Economic Area, an account opened from here is linked not to the FCA- or CySEC-regulated entity, but to the offshore entity in Comoros — meaning FSCS protection and the CySEC compensation fund do not apply to your account. MISA is a real licensing regime, but it is not supervision at the FCA/CySEC level. Additionally, the FCA has placed the addresses tiomarkets-trading.com and tiopremarkets.com on its warning list as clone firms impersonating the TIO name; these are not TIO's own websites. When opening an account, check both the address and which entity the contract is signed with.
tio-markets.faq.1.q: Does TIO Markets really provide unlimited leverage?
tio-markets.faq.1.a: Yes, but only on the Standard account. On Nano, Raw, and VIP Black accounts, leverage goes up to 1:500 upon request. It is necessary to state clearly what unlimited leverage means: margin requirements practically disappear, meaning you can open positions much larger than your balance allows. This magnifies losses just as much as profits and removes the natural brake that limits position size. A single adverse move in a small account can wipe out the balance. Unlimited leverage is an opportunity, not a strategy — set position size not according to leverage, but according to the amount you can afford to lose.
tio-markets.faq.2.q: What are the account types and minimum investment at TIO Markets?
tio-markets.faq.2.a: There are four account types. Nano: 20 dollars minimum, spread from 0,6 pips, 6 dollars commission per lot per round turn, MT5 only. Standard: 20 dollars minimum, spread from 1,1 pips, no commission, MT4 and MT5 — this is the only account type eligible for unlimited leverage. Raw: 250 dollars minimum, spread from 0.0 pips, 6 dollars commission per lot per round turn, MT4 and MT5. VIP Black: 1,000 dollars minimum, spread from 0,3 pips, no commission, MT4 and MT5. For someone wanting to start small and lower costs, the logical progression is to move from Standard to Raw; the commission on Raw only offsets the spread difference when your trading volume increases.
tio-markets.faq.3.q: How long does a withdrawal from TIO Markets take?
tio-markets.faq.3.a: Deposit and withdrawal transactions made with cryptocurrency are completed within minutes — this is the timeframe observed by FXPARTNER on its own account. Times on the bank and card side vary depending on the method and intermediary bank; we do not share an independently verified timeframe for these. As with any broker, account verification (KYC) must be completed prior to withdrawal.
tio-markets.faq.4.q: Is TIO Markets legal in Turkey, does it have an SPK license?
tio-markets.faq.4.a: No — TIO Markets does not have a Capital Markets Board (SPK) license and is not an investment institution based in Turkey. Accounts opened from Turkey are linked to the group's offshore company in Comoros. This is not unique to TIO Markets: almost all international brokers on the list operate with the same structure. Still, the meaning is clear — SPK's investor protection mechanisms do not apply to these accounts, and in a dispute, your counterparty is a company registered in Comoros.
